1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeAngleAccounting
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralAngles
3 
4 /-! Transfer the six actual original curvatures to the cut-tree vertices.
5 The source is absent from the tree; all other original vertices occur
6 exactly once, and subdivision vertices contribute zero. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
9 
10 open Real Set
11 open scoped BigOperators
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
14   {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
15 
16 /-- Original vertex curvature, extended by zero to the other tree vertices. -/
17 noncomputable def cutTreeCurvature (u : T.vertices) : ℝ :=
18   ∑ i : Fin 6, if (graph.vertex i : Space) = (u : Space) then graph.curvature i else 0
19 
20 theorem cutTreeCurvature_at_original (u : T.vertices) (i : Fin 6)
21     (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (graph.vertex i : Space)) :
22     graph.cutTreeCurvature T u = graph.curvature i := by
23   classical
24   have equal (j : Fin 6) : (graph.vertex j : Space) = (u : Space) ↔ j = i := by
25     rw [at_vertex]
26     exact ⟨fun h => graph.vertex.injective (Subtype.ext h), fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩
27   simp [cutTreeCurvature, equal]
28 
29 theorem cutTreeCurvature_at_nonvertex (u : T.vertices) (not_vertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
30     graph.cutTreeCurvature T u = 0 := by
31   classical
32   apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
33   intro i _
34   apply if_neg
35   intro equal
36   exact not_vertex (equal ▸ (graph.vertex i).property)
37 
38 /-- The cut tree contains precisely the original curvature other than the source's. -/
39 theorem sum_cutTreeCurvature [Fintype T.vertices] (source : Fin 6)
40     (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space)) :
41     ∑ u, graph.cutTreeCurvature T u = 4 * π - graph.curvature source := by
42   classical
43   have vertex_sum (i : Fin 6) :
44       (∑ u : T.vertices, if (graph.vertex i : Space) = (u : Space) then graph.curvature i else 0) =
45         if i = source then 0 else graph.curvature i := by
46     by_cases same : i = source
47     · subst i
48       rw [if_pos rfl]
49       apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
50       intro u _
51       apply if_neg
52       intro equal
53       exact T.vertex_ne_source u (equal.symm.trans at_source.symm)
54     · rw [if_neg same]
55       have different : (graph.vertex i : Space) ≠ (a : Space) := by
56         intro equal
57         exact same (graph.vertex.injective (Subtype.ext (equal.trans at_source)))
58       let v : T.vertices := ⟨graph.vertex i, T.original_vertex_mem (graph.vertex i).property different⟩
59       have equal (u : T.vertices) : (graph.vertex i : Space) = (u : Space) ↔ u = v :=
60         ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h.symm, fun h => by subst u; rfl⟩
61       simp only [equal]
62       simp
63   simp only [cutTreeCurvature]
64   rw [Finset.sum_comm]
65   simp_rw [vertex_sum]
66   have remove : (∑ i : Fin 6, if i = source then 0 else graph.curvature i) =
67       (∑ i : Fin 6, graph.curvature i) - graph.curvature source := by
68     calc
69       _ = ∑ i : Fin 6, (graph.curvature i - if i = source then graph.curvature source else 0) := by
70         apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
71         intro i _
72         split_ifs with same
73         · simp [same]
74         · simp
75       _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; simp
76   rw [remove, graph.sum_curvature]
77 
78 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
